title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to check if the time zone supports daylight saving time (DST) via AL
summary: This post explains how to check whether a time zone supports daylight saving time (DST) in Business Central using AL code. It demonstrates using the TimeZoneSupportsDaylightSavingTime method from codeunit 8720 to determine DST support and includes a practical page extension example.
key_points: Business Central stores all DateTime fields as UTC and converts them to user-specified time zones in the UI
The standard Time Zone table does not include daylight saving time information
Use codeunit 8720 'Time Zone' method TimeZoneSupportsDaylightSavingTime to check DST support for a time zone ID
The example shows adding a DST support field to the Time Zones Lookup page using a page extension

quotes.text: the standard Time Zone table does not include daylight saving time (DST). Is there a way to display it?
quotes.why_it_matters: This identifies the problem that the solution addresses
